notes.name: Games Station
notes.scope: A current-build walkthrough used for bounded observations of animals, crops, shops, NPC conversations and map recognition. The archive is a visual reference, not a replacement for an in-game test.
notes.zhScope: 一段带版本范围的实机流程视频，用于限定动物、作物、商店、NPC 对话和地图识别的观测。它是画面参考，不替代当前版本实测。
notes.use: We cite the relevant timestamp or use it to cross-check a page claim, then keep the observation tied to 0.8.10.455. We do not reproduce the creator's script, thumbnail or footage.
notes.zhUse: 本站只引用相关时间点或用它交叉核对页面结论，并把观测绑定到 0.8.10.455；不复制作者脚本、缩略图或视频画面。
notes.risk: The game has moved beyond this launch-build archive. Prices, prompts and bug behavior may have changed in later builds.
notes.zhRisk: 游戏已经超出这份首发版本存档。后续版本可能改变价格、提示语和 bug 行为。

notes.name: Steam Community Guides
notes.scope: A useful place to find player questions and test leads about shop hours, seed yields and animal production. The index does not make every guide authoritative.
notes.zhScope: 这里能找到玩家关于营业时间、种子产量和动物产出的提问与测试线索，但入口页不会让每篇攻略自动变成权威资料。
notes.use: We use a guide as a lead only when its version, steps and raw observation are visible. A claim enters a current answer only after an official response, a second independent record or a reproducible test supports it.
notes.zhUse: 只有在攻略显示版本、步骤和原始观测时，本站才把它当作线索。要进入当前答案，还需要官方答复、第二条独立记录或可复现实测。
notes.risk: Older guides can preserve Alpha-era values or conclusions. Check the build before using any number, opening hour or production rule.
notes.zhRisk: 旧攻略可能保留 Alpha 时代的数值或结论。使用任何数字、营业时间或产出规则前都要先检查版本。

notes.name: The Ranchers Official Wiki
notes.scope: A taxonomy and visual checklist for buildings, animals, items and places. It helps identify what to investigate, especially when a page names an entity or shows a building view.
notes.zhScope: 它提供建筑、动物、物品和地点的分类骨架与视觉检查清单，适合用来发现待研究实体，尤其是页面给出名称或建筑画面时。
notes.use: We use names and relationships as research leads, then keep current-build facts in our own evidence records. Historical values are not copied into current tables.
notes.zhUse: 本站只把名称和关系当研究线索，再用自己的证据记录当前版本事实；历史数值不会直接搬进当前表格。
notes.risk: Many pages retain pre-EA or Alpha-era values, and an image or category does not prove a current coordinate, recipe or unlock condition.
notes.zhRisk: 不少页面仍停留在 EA 前或 Alpha 时代；图片或分类不能证明当前坐标、配方或解锁条件。
